items.title: Add red/repro coverage for current non-consumption
items.context: M0: prove seeded active playbooks and dev-memory lessons are not currently surfaced by session_brief; also prove candidate playbooks remain inert. Related plan: docs/requirements/decisions/playbook-runtime-memory-consumption-execution-plan.md#M0.
items.userSees: A focused smoke first demonstrates the session memory/playbook non-consumption gap before the implementation path is claimed fixed.

happy.desc: Seed a dev-memory lesson plus an active playbook and prove pre-fix session_brief has no Memory Runtime Preflight pack or active playbook hit.

edge.desc: Seed a candidate playbook and prove it remains inert so red coverage does not confuse candidate inertness with the active-playbook consumption gap.

adversarial.desc: Prove no source digest/freshness pack exists pre-fix, so stale memory cannot be detected before the runtime pack is introduced.

items.title: Implement explicit active playbook activation boundary
items.context: M1: add a fail-closed activation path with canonical playbook digest and no-lost-update write safety; candidates remain inert until explicitly active.
items.userSees: A new explicit playbook activation path exists: candidates stay inert until activated with a matching digest, and stale/malformed activation is rejected.

happy.desc: A candidate playbook activated with the current expectedPlaybookDigest becomes active and then can be surfaced by the runtime matcher.

edge.desc: A candidate playbook without activation never surfaces in runtime consumers.

adversarial.desc: Stale expectedPlaybookDigest, malformed playbook shape, or concurrent write drift fails closed without losing existing playbooks.

items.title: Implement runtime matcher and freshness pack core
items.context: M2-M3: active-only matcher over small fixtures plus MemoryFreshnessPack with source digests, suppressed superseded IDs, 60-line render cap, stale-relevant/stale-irrelevant, and gateEvidence:false.
items.userSees: Runtime memory core can build a non-authoritative freshness pack with active-only playbook matches, source digests, superseded suppression, and stale classification.

happy.desc: Matcher finds an active playbook and relevant dev-memory entry from a small noisy fixture and records their IDs in MemoryFreshnessPack.
Freshness pack includes project/global/playbook/signature source digest fields and immediately verifies as fresh.

edge.desc: Superseded dev-memory entries are suppressed by default and their IDs appear in suppressedSupersededIds.
Rendered pack respects the 60-line cap and reports omittedCount instead of flooding output.

adversarial.desc: Candidate/stale/archived playbooks never match runtime consumers.
Relevant source mutation is detected as stale-relevant, while unrelated append-only churn is classified stale-irrelevant or non-blocking.
Pack remains gateEvidence:false and authority:non_authoritative in schema and render output.

items.title: Surface bounded memory/playbook pack in session_brief
items.context: M4: session_brief should include a bounded advisory memory/playbook section by default, without blocking the command or turning memory into gate evidence.

items.title: Validate MVP1 and document remaining parent milestones
items.context: Run build and focused smokes, record verification evidence, and keep M5-M12 explicitly out of MVP1 scope.
